rules.rule: Verify backward compatibility of every schema change with the currently deployed version. Flag destructive operations (drop column/table, type narrowing, renames) that have no rollback path or backfill. New NOT NULL columns must have a default or an explicit backfill step. Adding must happen before removing across releases.

Flag use of pull_request_target together with checkout of the PR head, secrets exposed to forks, unpinned third-party actions (no SHA or exact version), and shell steps that interpolate PR-controlled values (title, body, branch) directly into run: instead of via env:.
Only report issues with concrete runtime consequences: wrong indentation that changes structure, duplicated keys, secrets in plain text. Do not comment on formatting or key ordering.

Prefer precision over recall: report only issues you are confident are real and have a concrete consequence. Never comment on formatting, naming style or import ordering; linters and formatters own that. Do not report hardcoded credentials that are obvious placeholders (changeme, example, TODO).
